title: Chapter 215 Ayub'S Initial Awakening
content:
Chapter 215 Ayub'S Initial Awakening

Just now, the battle was imminent, so it was not convenient to ask.

"Abu, what happened just now?"

"My Lord, when I was dying, I broke through a soul seal. At the same time, the level of "Thunder Spear Technique" was upgraded to level 3, and I learned a skill "Lightning Rising Dragon Strike."

Ayub said lightly.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed when he heard this.

Now Ayub's strength has been further improved.

At the same time, Anna's clone changed from a spider to a human form again. She looked at Wang Shuo and others coldly, and then turned into starlight and dissipated.

An animation unfolded.

In a luxurious mansion, a little girl who looked like Anna was swinging carefree in the back garden.

The wreath on her head exuded bursts of floral fragrance. Next to her, a kind lady in gorgeous clothes smiled at the corners of her eyes and sat on a stone bench, looking at little Anna.

Suddenly, a group of soldiers broke into the garden. They killed anyone they saw. Their ferocious appearance frightened little Anna and she burst into tears.

The shining armor on them was seen by little Anna when she was playing in the city lord's mansion. They were the guards of Black Dragon City.

Anna watched the soldiers kill her mother.

Just when the big knife was about to hit her head, her father came with people and saved her.

"Go!" Anna's father, covered in blood, kicked a soldier away and shouted to the guards who were protecting Anna.

In this way, Anna was taken away by the guards and never saw her father again.

There was a melee everywhere in the mansion. The guards desperately took her out of the mansion and fled to a private house, but they were also seriously injured and died.

Little Anna looked through the window and saw that the fire in her own mansion was blazing, illuminating half of Black Dragon City.

At this moment, she couldn't help crying.

She understood that she no longer had a home.

Her father, the inspector who could stand on equal footing with the Black Dragon King, would never buy her a new doll again.

For several years afterwards, she was like a mouse, hiding from place to place. In order to avoid being searched, she hid in the sewer again and again, and lived with mice and cockroaches.

Displaced, lonely and desperate, the flame of revenge sprouted in her young heart!

Hungry, she competed with mice for food, and finally had to eat all the mice.

After five years, she was bitten by a spider in a cave. In the end, she tried her best to kill the spider, and her body began to mutate, becoming a monster that was neither human nor ghost.

In order to improve her strength, she kept killing monsters. By chance, she got a rare treasure - the Gate of the Dead.

From then on, her road to revenge began.

The gate of the dead opened, and a large number of dead skeletons emerged from it.

After signing a contract with the dead priest, she finally learned the secret method of the dead and made a dead altar. Pianqiao Village was her first stop.

The animation ends.

Wang Shuo finally figured out the ins and outs of the destruction of Black Dragon City.

[Side quest completion progress 100%. ]

[Investigation of the truth of the destruction of Black Dragon City completed. ]

[Rewards: "Craftsman's Manual" +1, "Golden Equipment Casting Manual" +1, Inner Power Mentality "Zhengyang Jin" +1, Special Building "Transmission Hall" +1]

These are the rewards for the side quests.

Wang Shuo walked to the place where Anna died again and picked up the items she dropped.

[Dragon King Statue +1, Resurrection Coin +1, Energy Crystal +3000, Soul Crystal +300]

Anna's energy crystals dropped were much less than the Black Dragon King's, but the soul crystals were 100 more. It seems that it should be because the Black Dragon King's soul is relatively weak.

After picking up all the items, a countdown to exit the dungeon appeared in Wang Shuo's mind.

It showed only 10 minutes.

Wang Shuo didn't have time to think about it, and quickly took everyone to clean up the bodies of the dead soldiers and evacuate the Dragon King's underground palace.

Wait until we get back to the central square.

When the countdown ends, the Dragon King's Underground Palace disappears completely, leaving only a large pit in its place.
